en.description: Turn a written class duty roster into one class duty voice clip per labeled cue. This duty roster voice studio records each class duty audio and roster reminder from the list the teacher already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 class duty voice pack files. Use it for duty clip packs that keep one roster item on each clip.
en.summary: Turn a written class duty roster into one class duty voice clip per labeled cue.
en.title: Class Duty Voice: Roster-to-Clip Reads
